name: Maren Taber Block-Heel Sandal
description: An open-toe block-heel sandal with architectural strap work across the vamp and ankle — wide bands of polished synth-leather in bone, black, or deep burgundy. The 6cm block heel is stable and practical. Maren Taber is a mid-luxury brand known for clean geometry. This sandal is dinner-party footwear, the kind worn by people who care about the full picture.
functionality: Adjustable strap buckles with micro-ratchet mechanism for precise fit. No active tech.
what_it_says: You have taste and the income to back it up. Social, refined, aware of how you're perceived.
story_hooks: The micro-ratchet buckle mechanism is almost identical to one used in a specific restraint device — a detail that comes up at an inconvenient moment.
Maren Taber's flagship store in the Tier 4 district is a known meeting point for a certain class of fixer.

physical_description.visual_profile: Architectural open-toe sandal with bold geometric strap work that frames the foot like a modernist sculpture. Clean lines, minimalist aesthetic with structural presence. Projects understated wealth and deliberate style curation.
physical_description.fit: Precise, tailored fit across the vamp and ankle. The block heel provides grounded stability without bulk. Straps wrap snugly but not constrictively, designed for someone with manicured feet and confident posture.
physical_description.primary_material: Polished synth-leather—the high-end variant with a subtle iridescent sheen that catches light without glaring. Durable, climate-controlled manufacturing ensures consistent quality across Φ300+ price point.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost glassy finish on the main strap bands. The sole has a micro-textured grip pattern. Heel cap shows subtle scuff-resistance treatment typical of Tier 1 footwear—designed to age gracefully, not degrade.
physical_description.color_scheme: Three colorways: bone (off-white with warm undertones), jet black, or deep burgundy with subtle metallic undertone. No logos visible—brand confidence expressed through proportions alone.
physical_description.closures: Open sandal format; ankle strap uses discreet magnetic micro-snap hidden within the overlap seam. Vamp straps are friction-fit, staying in place through precise tension geometry.
distinctive_features: Asymmetrical vamp strapping—wider bands across the toe box, narrower accent strap at the inner ankle
6cm geometric block heel with undercut profile (slightly concave sole)
Seamless strap integration—no visible stitching, molded appearance
Maren Taber signature: the 'Φ-curve' subtle concave detail on the heel side panel
Minimal wear surface—polish-resistant top coat, scuff-hide treatment on heel contact points
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. Retails around Φ380-450. Worn by corporate-adjacent professionals, mid-tier execs' partners, upscale service workers (high-end hospitality, designer boutiques).
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals discerning taste, disposable income, and attention to detail. Wearer likely frequents dinner clubs in the Upper District or corporate hospitality events. Not flashy augmentation culture—this is 'I know what good design is' signaling.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or well-maintained. Maren Taber buyers re-coat and refresh regularly. Evidence of wear (slight heel scuff, strap creasing) adds prestige—sign of an item worth maintaining rather than discarding.
